rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the punctuation mark.

example.english: Remember to add a question mark at the end of the sentence.
example.traditional: 你記得喺句尾加個問號。
example.jyutping: nei5 gei3 dak1 hai2 geoi3 mei5 gaa1 go3 man6 hou6

rows.note: Use this when an outcome or claim remains uncertain or questionable.

example.english: They say they didn't take the money, but there's a question mark over that claim.
example.traditional: 佢話自己冇收錢，但呢個講法有問號。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 sau1 cin2 daan6 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 jau5 man6 hou6
